description: D500: interleaved A/B of compose-rs's hint session target (docs/14, 'The session's target after D470'). a: main d978afa (the RenderThread's CPU time per frame against 6.5 ms, both threads in the session); b: the same against 6.0 ms; c: against 5.5 ms; d: the main thread's CPU time added to each report, against 8.33 ms (D442's c8). Pixel 8 Pro, speed, 10 runs per variant and scenario, variants rotating each round; CPU, work and energy (android.power rails, 250 ms) over 13 s (scroll) or 9 s (animation) from the measured start. model: the closed-loop simulation (NDK batching + Pixel PID, REFRESH_120FPS) on 8 traced runs of a.

summary.power_rule: runs whose other processes work (all but the app and the power HAL) exceeds 1.1 x the scenario median left out
